title.hr: Infrastruktura kao kod: konfiguracija, stanje i odmak
title.en: Infrastructure as code: configuration, state and drift

concept.hr: Željeno, zapisano i stvarno: plan pokazuje razliku
concept.en: Desired, recorded and real: plan shows the difference

summary.hr: Promijeni infrastrukturu ručno, uredi konfiguraciju ili izbriši zapis iz stanja pa pokreni plan: osvježavanje čita što stanje zna, razlika kaže što će apply.
summary.en: Change infrastructure by hand, edit the configuration or drop a state entry, then run plan: refresh reads what state knows, the diff says what apply will do.

concept.hr: Alat zaboravi objekt: plan predlaže novi, a apply pada na imenu
concept.en: The tool forgets an object: plan proposes a new one, apply fails on the name

concept.hr: -refresh-only upiše ručnu promjenu u stanje, ali plan je i dalje vraća
concept.en: -refresh-only writes the hand change into state, yet plan still reverts it
